  "title": "Move legal documents to /mozilla/legal-docs",
  "body": "Our legal documents are currently in https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/tree/master/legal-copy.\n\nWe should move them over to https://github.com/mozilla/legal-docs someday, since that's where the rest are (and will help l10n at some point).\n",
  "author": "Participant 1",
  "created_at": "2016-05-06T23:18:32Z",
  "updated_at": "2017-05-06T03:02:10Z",
  "state": "closed",
  "closed_at": null,
  "issue_fetched_at": "2026-11-05T07:19:09.152027+00:00",

    "2026-11-05T07:19:09.152027+00:00",

  ],
  "expected_comment_count": 12,
  "retrieved_comment_count": 12,
  "comments_complete": true,
  "comments": [
    {
      "id": 217996837,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-217996837",
      "created_at": "2016-05-09T21:33:38Z",
      "updated_at": "2016-05-11T20:06:37Z",
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Ref: https://github.com/mozilla/legal-docs/pull/509\nI made a pull request against **mozilla/legal-docs** to add a package.json, which will let us do something like this and add the legal-docs repo :\n\n``` bash\n$ npm install mozilla/legal-docs -D\n```\n\nThen I think we'll just need to move over our legal *.md files and blah, blah, blah.\n\n---\n\nIn **fxa-content-server** we used the [bower.json](https://github.com/mozilla/fxa-content-server/blob/4450796bed0224a617b5cbd201895a22647c9d77/bower.json#L37) file to specify the **mozilla/legal-docs** as a dependency, but I'd rather not add Bower to this stack just for that one repo.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 218821368,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-218821368",
      "created_at": "2016-05-12T17:04:37Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Upstream **legal-docs** package.json fix was merged (thanks @clouserw!), in case anybody wants to jump on this before I get around to it.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 220063420,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-220063420",
      "created_at": "2016-05-18T15:27:52Z",
      "updated_at": "2016-05-18T20:58:33Z",
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "~~Received the following request from Brian Smith in legal (also updated bug title, and opening):~~\n\n> I noticed that the Test Pilot privacy notice webpage does not have the sections collapsed like our other [privacy notices](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/privacy/firefox/). Can we please revise to make the two sections of the notice collapse/expand? Denelle does not like our notices to just be a wall of text, so this is a priority for us.\n> \n> Casey (cc'd) can help the relevant person on your team with the css/html formatting as needed.\n\n/cc @mozcmcgill\n\n/edit addressing in #877.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 220067925,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-220067925",
      "created_at": "2016-05-18T15:42:00Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@ckprice This sounds like a separate issue, maybe to be made as a follow up to this one.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 220151774,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-220151774",
      "created_at": "2016-05-18T20:42:29Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "> _This sounds like a separate issue, maybe to be made as a follow up to this one._\n\nFiled as #877\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 227591483,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-227591483",
      "created_at": "2016-06-21T22:28:16Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Another legal hiccup, but in the [**mozilla/legal-docs** firefox_cloud_services_PrivacyNotice](https://github.com/mozilla/legal-docs/tree/master/firefox_cloud_services_PrivacyNotice) we have localized versions of the legal docs. So we'll need something like dis:\n\n```\nmozilla/legal-docs/\n  - testpilot_privacy-notice/\n    - de.md\n    - en-US.md\n    - es-ES.md\n    - fr.md\n    - it.md\n    - ...\n\n  - testpilot_terms-of-use/\n    - de.md\n    - en-US.md\n    - es-ES.md\n    - fr.md\n    - it.md\n    - ...\n```\n\nSo when we move our legal docs over to **mozilla/legal-docs**, we'll also need to add another depth so the Privacy Notice and Terms of Use legal docs can be translated.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 256773612,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-256773612",
      "created_at": "2016-10-27T21:21:47Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "We talked about this in a meeting with the legal team, but I forget the outcome.  As I recall, they seemed ho-hum about it like it wasn't a big deal.  English is fine, localizing is a bonus.  @ckprice - is that your recollection?  If so I won't feel as bad about not doing this yet.  \n"
    },
    {
      "id": 258252902,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-258252902",
      "created_at": "2016-11-03T19:44:41Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "@clouserw i think we should revisit this in the next sprint, right now i don't think these files are getting localized. I imagine that's a hard requirement for the German launch.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 258257468,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-258257468",
      "created_at": "2016-11-03T20:02:16Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "> I imagine that's a hard requirement for the German launch.\n\nI don't know for sure about this -- @eleemoz?\n\nAlso, as IIRC putting these docs in the repo doesn't automagically get them localized. This was more of an organizational thing for the legal team. /cc @caseymcgill\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 258257919,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-258257919",
      "created_at": "2016-11-03T20:03:54Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "@ckprice yeah, i didn't mean to conflate the issues here. Right now we aren't localizing these things, but we'll need to.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 277308925,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-277308925",
      "created_at": "2017-02-03T17:26:47Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 6",
      "body": "We'll follow up on this next Monday in our legal meeting"
    },
    {
      "id": 278392980,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla/testpilot/issues/738#issuecomment-278392980",
      "created_at": "2017-02-08T17:09:54Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Both these folders in the **mozilla/legal-docs** repo currently have translations for _en-US.md_ and _de-DE.md_:\r\n\r\nhttps://github.com/mozilla/legal-docs/tree/master/firefox_testpilot_PrivacyNotice\r\nhttps://github.com/mozilla/legal-docs/tree/master/firefox_testpilot_Terms\r\n"
    }
  ],
